title: FactoryProjectAdapterConfig
description: Configuration schema for .factory.yml project adapters in External Core Factory

base_branch.description: Default base branch to fork and PR against

verify_command.description: Shell command to execute build & test verification

package_manager.description: Package manager used (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, poetry, uv, cargo, go)

exclude_skills.description: List of global skill names to exclude from this project worktree

github_user.description: Optional GitHub username override for PR operations

memory_tier.description: Memory tiering mode for project runs
